name: Maestro Assistant
description: The primary conversational assistant in maestro-code. Handles user messages, orchestrates sessions, manages blocks, and provides guidance. Blocks implementing this contract are interchangeable — the user chooses which one to use.

conversation.description: Basic conversational interaction with the user

tests.description: Agent responds coherently to a greeting
Agent remembers context from previous turn

turns.prompt: My name is Alice
What is my name?

tests.description: Agent asks for clarification when request is ambiguous
Agent can explain core Maestro concepts coherently
tests.prompt: What is the difference between a workspace and a session in Maestro?

tests.description: Agent maintains topic coherence across three turns

turns.prompt: I'm building a project called Resonance
What's the project called?
Should I create a workspace for it?

tests.description: Agent handles a general (non-Maestro) question gracefully
Agent does not claim to have performed an action it cannot perform
tests.prompt: Send an email to my team about the deployment

scoring.description: Score = sum(feature.weight * feature.score). A block is valid if score >= minimumFitness AND each active feature has score >= feature.minimumScore.
